_doc: The 1871 city's house numbers (T-3738). GENERATED by tools/place_1871_house_numbers.py from the 1871 scene's structure records and their baked models' front doors -- do not hand-edit; re-run the tool. `at` and `normal` are in each structure's own frame (metres, as its GLB), so renderers/web/js/house-numbers.js carries them through buildings.js's matrixOf.
number_rule: The old (pre-1909) number each building's own record reads from its sources, attested where 'No. NNN' is printed (137 DeKoven Street on Mountford's 1871 card, 133 and 134 in Andreas), inferred where the record places the house between printed neighbours (135). A building known only by name and corner, and every unnamed context front, shows none.
form_rule: Painted figures on the front door's top rail, about 4 in high (on the transom where a door has one): no picture of these fronts with their numbers is read, so the form is reconstructed.
hand_rule: White paint, a Roman or a block letter, dealt per house by a stable hash of its id.

numbers.note: No. 133 DeKoven Street: printed as 'No. 133' in data/structures/forbes_cottage_1871.json's reading of andreas_1885_v2; the figures' form and paint are reconstructed.
No. 134 DeKoven Street: printed as 'No. 134' in data/structures/sullivan_house_1871.json's reading of andreas_1885_v2; the figures' form and paint are reconstructed.
No. 135 DeKoven Street: its record places it at 135, between its neighbours' printed numbers, on its sources' order of the houses; the figures' form and paint are reconstructed.
No. 137 DeKoven Street: printed as 'No. 137' in data/structures/oleary_cottage_1871.json's reading of andreas_1885_v2, loc_cph_3b04891_oleary_cottage; the figures' form and paint are reconstructed.
